_1: ^^ THE ONLY REQUIRED FIELD. Everything below is optional and has a working default.
_language: null = detected from the channel on the first run. Set 'en', 'it', ... to force it.
_2: --- Optional: narrow the corpus to topics you care about. Omit and every segment is kept.
_topics: {name: regex}. What the indexer tags, and what novelty is measured against. null = no filtering.
_3: --- Optional: the AI reading pass. Needs Ollama AND a rubric; without both, run.sh skips it.
_rubric: The numbered list of what you already know. The reading pass reports only what it does NOT cover.
_4: --- Optional: transcribing videos that have no captions (needs ./setup.sh to build the venv).
_5: --- Optional: language mechanics. null = sensible English defaults.
